title: Electric Juicer Machine USB Rechargeable Juicer 360 Degree Motor Juice Squeezer For Lemon Orange Citrus DC7.4V
body_html: 1、Applications: This electric juicer can extract orange, pear, grape, lemon, watermelon, pomegranate, and other fruits, juice and residue separation, compact and practical. 2、360 Degree Motor: This juicer machine uses a 360 degree all round motor to help you obtain juice from pulp residues without the need for seed removal or peeling. 3、Leakproof Spout: This citrus juicer is equipped with a convenient spout that makes it easy to pour out juice and prevent dirtying your kitchen counter or tabletop. 4、Power Supply: The electric juicer machine is equipped with a 1500mAh polymer lithium battery and is charged using USB C to ensure multiple juicing on a full charge. 5、Safe Materials: This citrus juicer is made of food grade materials, safe and environment friendly, can be used with confidence, and equipped with brush for cleaning.Item Type: Electric JuicerMaterial: PC Cup, PP, Food Grade SiliconeFunction: Juice and Pulp SeparationProduct Size: Approx. 25 x 13.5 x 13.5cm / 9.8 x 5.3 x 5.3inRated Power Supply: DC7.4VMotor Power: 45WBattery: 1500mAh Polymer Lithium Battery (included)Weight: Approx. 1418g / 50oz1 x Juice Extractor1 x Juicing Head1 x Top Lid1 x USB Cable1 x Brush
